card.name: Hyphen or space before a capital C
card.fires_on: The spot just before a word starting with C, often a hyphen or space after a prefix like non, anti, ex or Ph+, as in non-cancerous, Ph+ CML or ex-CNN.

modes.label: Hyphen before c-word
modes.description: A hyphen after non, anti or ex, right before a word starting with c.
modes.example: This strain can cause genital warts, mouth lesions or non<<-c>>ancerous throat tumors.

modes.label: Space before CML
modes.description: The gap after Ph+ and before the letters CML in leukemia dosing text.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION • Adult patients with newly-diagnosed chronic phase Ph+<< C>>ML: 400 mg orally

modes.label: Other c-word starts
modes.description: A word before a c-word such as cancer or crouching.

card.writes: It mostly pushes odd tokens, including non-English characters, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It notices when the next word is about to begin with a C, such as after non- or Ph+.
